description: Exact crate source archives retained by the cached rav1e build step; includes optional, development and build dependencies, not a claim that every crate is linked.
build_recipe_note: scripts.d/50-rav1e.sh runs cargo update cc before cargo cinstall. The same layer contains the installed librav1e.a and these cached source archives. 272 crate checksums match the original Cargo.lock; three updated/new checksums match the build layer sparse registry index. The post-update project Cargo.lock was removed by upstream run_stage cleanup and has not been reconstructed.

opt/ffdest/opt/ffbuild/lib/pkgconfig/rav.text:
prefix=/opt/ffbuild
exec_prefix=${prefix}
libdir=${prefix}/lib
includedir=${prefix}/include

Name: rav1e
Description: The fastest and safest AV1 encoder
Version: 0.8.0
Libs: -L${libdir} -lrav1e -lkernel32 -lntdll -luserenv -lws2_32 -ldbghelp
Cflags: -I${includedir}/rav1e
Libs.private: -lkernel32 -lntdll -luserenv -lws2_32 -ldbghelp
